texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: For whom does the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form need to be completed?
texts.text: For whom does the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form need to be completed?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  The form is to be completed for all students who require testing accommodations based on needs documented in their:
texts.text:  The form is to be completed for all students who require testing accommodations based on needs documented in their:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  Current Individualized Education Program (IEP),
texts.text:  Current Individualized Education Program (IEP),

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  Current Section 504 Plan,
texts.text:  Current Section 504 Plan,

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  Current Limited English Proficient (LEP) Documentation, or
texts.text:  Current Limited English Proficient (LEP) Documentation, or

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  Current Transitory Impairment (TI) Documentation.
texts.text:  Current Transitory Impairment (TI) Documentation.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: For which tests does the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form need to be completed?
texts.text: For which tests does the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form need to be completed?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  One Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form must be completed for each state test for students who are required to receive testing accommodations.
texts.text:  One Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form must be completed for each state test for students who are required to receive testing accommodations.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  State tests requiring a Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form include the Beginningof-Grade 3 English Language Arts/Reading Test, End-of-Grade Tests, End-of-Course Tests, CTE Post-Assessments, the ACCESS for ELLs Test, the NC Final Exams, and the College and Career Readiness Alternate Assessments.
texts.text:  State tests requiring a Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form include the Beginningof-Grade 3 English Language Arts/Reading Test, End-of-Grade Tests, End-of-Course Tests, CTE Post-Assessments, the ACCESS for ELLs Test, the NC Final Exams, and the College and Career Readiness Alternate Assessments.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  The Review of Accommodations Used During NCEXTEND1 Testing form must be completed for all NCEXTEND1 tests.
texts.text:  The Review of Accommodations Used During NCEXTEND1 Testing form must be completed for all NCEXTEND1 tests.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  In addition, the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form must be completed for any state field test or special study.
texts.text:  In addition, the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form must be completed for any state field test or special study.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: What is the process for the completion of the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form?
texts.text: What is the process for the completion of the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  The top and left-hand column of the form (i.e., student-identifying information, required testing accommodations, signature line) are to be completed at the student's IEP/Section 504/LEP/TI team meeting where testing accommodations decisions are discussed and documented.  All appropriate individuals must be present at this meeting.
texts.text:  The top and left-hand column of the form (i.e., student-identifying information, required testing accommodations, signature line) are to be completed at the student's IEP/Section 504/LEP/TI team meeting where testing accommodations decisions are discussed and documented.  All appropriate individuals must be present at this meeting.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  The original form is kept with the student's accommodations documentation.
texts.text:  The original form is kept with the student's accommodations documentation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  A copy of the form is provided to the designated school employee to ensure the data is correctly entered into the electronic accommodations management system being used by the school (CECAS, PowerSchool, third-party system).
texts.text:  A copy of the form is provided to the designated school employee to ensure the data is correctly entered into the electronic accommodations management system being used by the school (CECAS, PowerSchool, third-party system).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  A copy of the form is provided to the test administrator on testing day to be completed during the testing session.  The test administrator records the following information:
texts.text:  A copy of the form is provided to the test administrator on testing day to be completed during the testing session.  The test administrator records the following information:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  Whether or not testing accommodations are provided to the student,
texts.text:  Whether or not testing accommodations are provided to the student,

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  Whether or not the student used the provided testing accommodations, as well as notes on how the accommodations were used, and
texts.text:  Whether or not the student used the provided testing accommodations, as well as notes on how the accommodations were used, and

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  Any other relevant comments or recommendations for the team/committee to discuss while making accommodations decisions.
texts.text:  Any other relevant comments or recommendations for the team/committee to discuss while making accommodations decisions.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: What happens with the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form after testing?
texts.text: What happens with the Review of Accommodations Used During Testing form after testing?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  The completed form is filed with the student's accommodations documentation.
texts.text:  The completed form is filed with the student's accommodations documentation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig:  The form is reviewed by the team/committee during the next meeting where accommodations decisions are made
texts.text:  The form is reviewed by the team/committee during the next meeting where accommodations decisions are made
